origin: Independent procedural specification; no benchmark examples or teacher inputs

signal_graph.objects: 6-8 nodes in a directed acyclic graph
signal_graph.rules: synchronous Boolean reachability at bounded horizon 1-4

spatial_composition.objects: six grid tokens with glyph and color attributes; visible regions
spatial_composition.rules: FILTER, UNION, INTERSECTION, COUNT; LEFT_OF, ABOVE, INSIDE

finite_state.objects: two unary Boolean operator glyphs, sequence length 2-4

split: semantic family hash assigned before render variants or views; smoke uses only train families
training_gate: requires frozen-manifest external rights/contamination approval and model preprocessing check
